data.name: Kesava
data.gender_notes: Kesava is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kesava is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kesari', meaning 'having black hair'. This name is associated with Lord Vishnu and is often used to refer to him. The name Kesava signifies one who 'steals' sins from the hearts of devotees and frees them from the cycle of birth and death. The name Kesava carries the meaning “Stealer of Sins” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kesava usually hope their child will grow to embody stealer of sins and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who absolves devotees from their sins
data.etymology: Kesava belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Stealer of Sins.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kesava total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kesava has a rich cultural significance in Hinduism. It holds special reverence in the Vaishnavite tradition, where Lord Vishnu is the supreme deity. The name 'Kesava' is part of various popular names of Lord Vishnu, such as 'Keshavanarayana', and 'Kesavaji'. These names express the divine qualities of Lord Vishnu and are celebrated through various rituals, folktales, and literature.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Kesava is an embodiment of compassion, love, and purity. In Hindu philosophy, Lord Vishnu is known to take on various forms and incarnations to save the world from evil and preserve dharma (cosmic order). The name Kesava signifies the protective and redeeming aspects of the deity, who absolves devotees of their sins and offers them salvation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kesava is a Sanskrit name, a form of Krishna. It means 'the possessor of beautiful hair'. In Hinduism, long and radiant hair is a symbol of divine grace, power, and auspiciousness. Thus, Kesava is a name that embodies the divine beauty and all-powerful nature of Krishna.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The name Kesava is mentioned in the Rigveda as a name of the god Vishnu. The name Kesava carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name is used in the context of Hindu mythology and the worship of Vishnu.
